goal: Apply reuse-first-v1 to the freshly recompiled readiness program, verify the selected canonical capability contract, and materialize one bounded next implementation wave without choosing unresolved technical details.
outputs: next bounded capability wave manifest and child decomposition
invariants: product runtime code is not changed by scaling-control tasks

canonical capability file resolves inside Product Spec
